storyTitle: Nvidia's stock has its best day in over two decades, igniting a $1 trillion Wall Street rally
insight: One reinstated CEO added nearly $1 trillion in a day and erased two indexes' corrections: this market's AI bet is that concentrated.
linkedin:

That one move pulled the S&P 500 up 4.73% and the Nasdaq up 6.51%, both out of correction.

When one stock decides the mood of two indexes, the market's AI bet is far more concentrated than it looks.

thread: Nvidia's stock jumped 31% on Monday. It added close to $1 trillion in one day and lifted Wall Street out of correction. Here's what mattered 👇

Nvidia's board reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO, eleven days after forcing him out. It said it got input from senior levels of the US government. A public U-turn this fast says a lot about how split the board was.
The stock closed up 31.48% at $165.05. The S&P 500 rose 4.73% and the Nasdaq 6.51%, their best days since April 2025. One stock moved two indexes. That's how concentrated this market is.
Trump said he was represented in the board meeting. Nvidia hasn't confirmed that. The probe into Huang's conduct goes on, with closed-door congressional questions on December 1-2.

Amazon is reportedly close to paying up to $7.5 billion for AI video startup Decart. Its May valuation was $4 billion. Amazon already supplies Decart with chips, so this is about owning the whole stack.
Back home, the Sensex fell 1,483.72 points on Monday, with Bank Nifty down about 3%. India closed hours before Wall Street's rally, so Monday's drop says little about Tuesday's open.
Today in one line: a single CEO decision moved a trillion dollars and showed how much the market leans on one stock. Full brief, free: https://the-hour-brief.vercel.app/e/2026-11-24

facts: Nvidia closed up 31.48% at $165.05 on Monday, adding close to $1 trillion in market value.
The S&P 500 rose 4.73% to 7,237.17 and the Nasdaq 6.51%, both their best days since April 2025.
Nvidia's board said it had input from senior levels of the US government before reinstating Huang.
Colette Kress, who was interim CEO at Nvidia, goes back to her role as CFO.
Amazon is reportedly near a deal of up to $7.5 billion for Decart, valued at $4 billion in May.
Microsoft's license to OpenAI's tech runs through 2032 under a non-exclusive deal revised in April.
The Sensex fell 1,483.72 points to 82,435.99 on Monday, while the Nifty IT index gained about 2%.
Target's sales rose 7.1% to about $27.1 billion, and Walmart's US e-commerce sales jumped 28%.

leaders.title: Anthropic's IPO Starts the Bubble Test, While Cheaper Models Steal the Week
leaders.post:
Anthropic's record IPO isn't the story. The lockup schedule is.

Matt Wolfe says employees could sell 10% on day one, with more unlocking from mid-December.

Up to 1.6 billion insider shares can eventually trade, more than the IPO itself.

If those who know the company best hold, it signals it's still early; heavy selling could be the first crack.
